By virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by the act of June 25,
1910 (ch. 421, 36 Stat. 847), as amended by the act of August: 24, 1912 (ch. 369,
37 Stat. 497), and subject to the conditions therein expressed and to all valid existing
rights, it is ordered that the following-described public lands in the States of Loui-
siana and Mississippi be, and they are hereby, temporarily withdrawn from settle-
ment, location, sale, or entry, for classification and pending determination as to the
advisability of including such lands in national forests:
